name: Ryuuki Denshou 3 ~Tasogare ni Michibiita Monotachi~
original_name: 竜機伝承3 ～黄昏に導いた者たち～
source:
Knight defeated an evil dragon, but his shrine maiden lover also died as a result. Now the devastated lover gathers forces to conquer the world.
Hero is an adventurer who is requested to investigate the circumstances of northern fort destruction overnight.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
骑士击败了邪龙，但他的巫女恋人也因此死去。如今，这名悲痛欲绝的恋人集结力量，企图征服世界。

主人公是一名冒险者，受托调查北方要塞一夜之间被摧毁的经过。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
